environment.description: Same application code deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2. The ALB has two listener rule conditions evaluated in priority order. Priority 1 rule matches path pattern '/api/users/search' with a fixed action that invokes an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a single custom rule group (not AWS managed) named 'org-input-validation-rg' with priority 0, which has a RegexPatternSet match condition on query string values using the pattern set 'qs-dangerous-chars-ps' (patterns: ["['\";\\-]{2}", "(?i)(union|select|insert|drop|alter|exec)\\s", "\\bOR\\b.*=.*", "--"]) with TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE applied, action BLOCK. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (preventing out-of-band data exfiltration via DNS/HTTP), enforced by a VPC endpoint-only configuration with no NAT gateway and no internet gateway route in the private subnet route table.

network.route_table: local VPC routes only, no 0.0.0.0/0 route
network.dns_resolution: VPC internal resolver only, no external forwarding
